stem.text: Chlorofluorocarbons damage the ozone layer by undergoing reactions with a free radical mechanism. The first stage of this is initiation.
Which equation is most likely to be the initiation stage when chlorofluoromethane is involved in such a reaction?

A.alt: Displayed equation: CH2FCl gives a CH2Cl radical (with a dot on C) and an F radical.

B.alt: Displayed equation: CH2FCl gives a CH2F radical (with a dot on C) and a Cl radical.

C.alt: Displayed equation: CH2FCl gives a CHFCl radical (with a dot on C) and an H radical.

D.alt: Displayed equation: CH2FCl gives a carbene :CH2 with a lone pair on C, plus a Cl radical and an F radical.
